handoff.salientSummary: Extracted `@repo/zoned-time` from `packages/staffing/src/tz.ts` (re-exporting in `@repo/staffing` with all 634 staffing tests passing) and implemented the pure `@repo/reservations` domain package (flags, permissions, token claims, DST-safe time math, config schemas & validator, service resolution, availability/pacing/calendar/waitlist engine, best-fit assignment/repair/reflow/conflict detection, state machine, policy/fee math, message scheduling/dedupe, strict Zod schemas, shared phone normalization, and 300-run property + scale tests).
handoff.whatWasImplemented:
1. Extracted pure IANA time-zone and calendar primitives into `packages/zoned-time` (`@repo/zoned-time`: `isValidTimeZone`, `localParts`, `tzOffsetMs`, `zonedLocalToUtc`, `parseLocalTimestamp`, `startOfLocalDay`, `addLocalDays`, `localMinutesSinceMidnight`, `addDays`, `daysBetween`, `dayOfWeek`, `businessDateOf`, `businessDayStartMs`) and re-exported `@repo/zoned-time` from `packages/staffing/src/tz.ts` with zero regression on `@repo/staffing`.
2. Created `packages/reservations` (`@repo/reservations`) with zero runtime dependencies beyond `zod` and `@repo/zoned-time`, no I/O, no UI strings, and injected `now`:
   - `src/flags.ts`: `RESERVATIONS_FLAGS`, `DEFAULT_RESERVATIONS_FLAGS`, `foldReservationsFlags`, and `parsePlatformFeeBp`.
   - `src/permissions.ts` & `src/token.ts`: `RESERVATIONS_PERMISSIONS`, `RESERVATIONS_ROLE_PRESETS`, `computeEffectiveReservationsPermissions` (write implies read, impersonation strips writes), `hasLocationScope`, and `reservationsOperatorTokenClaimsSchema` (`typ: 'rsv+jwt'`, `aud: 'tenant-api-reservations-operator'`).
   - `src/time.ts`: `localToInstant` (spring-forward gap shifts forward with `gapAdjusted: true`, fall-back fold picks earlier occurrence with `disambiguated: 'earlier'`), `instantToLocal`, `currentBusinessDate`, `resolveServiceWindow`, `formatHhmm`, and `parseHhmm`.
   - `src/config/*` & `src/config.ts`: Setup Zod schemas (`locationSettingsSchema`, `diningAreaSchema`, `tableSchema`, `combinationSchema`, `decorElementSchema`, `floorPlanSaveSchema`, `serviceSchema`, `turnTimeBucketSchema`, `pacingRuleSchema`, `serviceTableAvailabilitySchema`, `specialDaySchema`, `policyRuleSchema`) and `validateConfig`.
   - `src/rules/resolve-services.ts` & `src/services.ts`: `resolveServices` with special-day precedence (`closed` > `replace` > `modified` > `online_closed` > weekly template), supporting both `daysOfWeek` and `days_mask`, `effective_from`/`effective_to`, `special_day_id`, and midnight-crossing `endMin > 1440`.
   - `src/engine/*`, `src/waitlist/quote.ts`, `src/engine.ts`, & `src/assign.ts`: `OccupancyIndex`, `buildCandidates`/`buildDayState`, `isBookingHardLocked`, `evaluatePacing`, `scoreCandidate`, `assignTables`/`planBooking`/`tryRepair` (bounded 1-step & 2-step swap repair within `MAX_REPAIR_EXPANSIONS = 200`), `reflowDay`/`reflow` (`MAX_DAY_EXPANSIONS = 2000`), `detectConflicts`, `searchAvailability`, `suggestAlternatives`/`alternatives`, `calendarSummary`/`calendarAvailabilitySummary` (`MAX_CALENDAR_EXPANSIONS = 5000`), `searchExperienceAvailability`, and `quoteWait`.
   - `src/state-machine.ts`, `src/policy.ts`, `src/messages.ts`, `src/phone.ts`, `src/errors.ts`, & `src/schemas/*`: Booking state machine transitions, 10-minute undo window, `quickActionsFor`, policy selection/snapshot/cancellation/no-show/platform-fee math, quiet-hours message scheduling/dedupe/regional channels, shared E.164 phone normalization (also shared with `apps/tenant-api/src/routes/auth.ts` via `apps/tenant-api/src/lib/phone.ts`), error codes, and `.strict()` Zod API/internal schemas.
   - `src/testing/*` (`@repo/reservations/testing`), `src/engine/engine.property.test.ts`, & `src/engine/scale.test.ts`: Brute-force oracle (`bruteForceCanFit`, `bruteForceAssignSlot`, `bruteForceAvailableSlotMins`), fast-check arbitraries, 300-run property tests, and 120-table/80-combo/900-booking scale tests.
